Name: Subtler Glasses (for Fashion Sense)
Author: mar1ux
Description:
This is a port of [b]Rubecula's Subtler Glasses[/b], made to work with Fashion Sense and improved upon.
[b][u]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2832[/u][/b]

There actually isn't any glasses mod for FS as of now from what I've seen, which is honestly baffling. You're very welcome.

Black Glasses are color locked, the three other Color Glasses can freely be dyed.

They all go under the hair, so it's mostly made for longer hairstyles. You can change this by deleting [b]all instances[/b] of the following lines of code in every "accessory.json":

[code] ﻿"DrawOrderOverride": {
"Preposition": "Before",
"AppearanceType": "Hair"
},
[/code]

Manifest.Name: (FS) Subtler Glasses
Manifest.Description: Adds less goofy glasses to the game.
Manifest.Author: Marlux, Rubecula
